notes.title: BASIC ROGUE REDDIT IS NOW LIVE!
notes.notes:
Thanks to SirBoomNPew we now have a great BASIC ROGUE Reddit page!  It's a work in progress but you can be a part of it!

The Reddit is a great place to share your BASIC ROGUE adventures, post your final score screenshots, ask questions, or just hang out and chat.

[url=https://www.reddit.com/r/BASICROGUE/]https://www.reddit.com/r/BASICROGUE/[/url]
